biography:
I'm an AI/ML researcher and Research Fellow at CPX Lab (CSU Long Beach), studying coordination failures and trust in multi-agent AI systems. My work spans a diagnostic framework for detecting adversarial and communication failures in multi-agent systems and an open-source tool for assessing AI compliance with the EU AI Act.
I came to AI research from a political science background, and I now focus on bridging technical AI development and governance, particularly accountability gaps in under-resourced regulatory contexts.
